mentions.name: guile-flac
mentions.description: A FLAC encoder/decoder written in Guile Scheme. The decoder is now mostly fully functional and works 1:1 with the reference meta-flac command.
mentions.source_excerpt: A FLAC encoder/decoder written in Guile scheme. I struggled to get the decoder working with most test files for a while until recently. It's more or less a fully functional decoder now. It's also 1:1 with the reference meta-flac command currently as well.
